test_leaked_mock_by_default: test that GMockLeakTest catches leaked mock objects by default using ExpectCall and OnCall
test_leaked_mock_disabled: test that GMockLeakTest does not catch leaked mocks when gmock_catch_leaked_mocks is set to 0
test_leaked_mock_enabled: test that GMockLeakTest catches leaked mocks when gmock_catch_leaked_mocks flag is enabled
test_leaked_mock_explicit_flag: test that GMockLeakTest catches leaked mocks when gmock_catch_leaked_mocks is explicitly set to 1
test_multiple_leaked_mocks: test that GMockLeakTest catches multiple leaked mock objects in a single test run
